subject: English 2nd Paper

items.text:
Make four sentences from the substitution table.
Flood | know | our communication.
It | is | in our country.
It often | disrupts | a natural disaster.
We | occurs | what floods do to us.
items.explanation:
Suggested answers, teacher review required:
1. Flood is a natural disaster.
2. It occurs in our country.
3. It often disrupts our communication.
4. We know what floods do to us.

items.text:
Make four sentences from the substitution table.
A crow | flew | to drink water.
He | was | a jar in a garden.
At last he | found | very thirsty.
 | wanted | from one place to another in search of water.
items.explanation:
Suggested answers, teacher review required:
1. A crow was very thirsty.
2. He wanted to drink water.
3. He flew from one place to another in search of water.
4. At last he found a jar in a garden.

items.text:
Make four sentences from the substitution table.
Water | is | safe for use.
It |  | essential for all living beings.
Clean water |  | an important element of the environment.
 |  | polluted in many ways.
items.explanation:
Suggested answers, teacher review required:
1. Water is an important element of the environment.
2. It is essential for all living beings.
3. Clean water is safe for use.
4. Water is polluted in many ways.

items.text:
Make four sentences from the substitution table.
Honesty | is | an honest man.
An honest man | dislikes | always truthful.
He never | does | the best of all virtues.
Nobody | is | any harm to anybody.
items.explanation:
Suggested answers, teacher review required:
1. Honesty is the best of all virtues.
2. An honest man is always truthful.
3. He never does any harm to anybody.
4. Nobody dislikes an honest man.

items.text:
Make four sentences from the substitution table.
The farmer | took | of the safety of the money.
He | dug | away his sleep.
Yet he always | kept | the money there.
The money | thought | a hole in his hut.
items.explanation:
Suggested answers, teacher review required:
1. The farmer dug a hole in his hut.
2. He kept the money there.
3. Yet he always thought of the safety of the money.
4. The money took away his sleep.

items.text:
Make four sentences from the substitution table.
 | is | from the Federal Institute of Technology in Zurich.
Albert Einstein | received | the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921.
He | was born | in Germany in 1879 AD.
 | graduated | one of the greatest scientists of modern age.
items.explanation:
Suggested answers, teacher review required:
1. Albert Einstein was born in Germany in 1879 AD.
2. He graduated from the Federal Institute of Technology in Zurich.
3. He received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921.
4. Albert Einstein is one of the greatest scientists of modern age.

items.text:
Make four sentences from the substitution table.
Culture | have | a part of Bangladeshi culture
We | is | some special qualities in our customs, ideas and manners
Hospitality | includes | a term used for a way of life
It |  | a society’s beliefs, customs, languages and so on
items.explanation:
Suggested answers, teacher review required:
1. Culture is a term used for a way of life.
2. We have some special qualities in our customs, ideas and manners.
3. Hospitality is a part of Bangladeshi culture.
4. It includes a society’s beliefs, customs, languages and so on.

items.text:
Make four sentences from the substitution table.
Television | provides | harmful to us.
It | is | a scientific invention.
But watching TV for a long time | gives | us with news and views.
 |  | us entertainment.
items.explanation:
Suggested answers, teacher review required:
1. Television is a scientific invention.
2. It provides us with news and views.
3. It gives us entertainment.
4. But watching TV for a long time is harmful to us.
